responsibility: This file implements the wlists container as a chunked linked list of fixed-size WORD arrays. It manages allocation and disposal of list nodes, appends and replaces WORD elements across chunks, supports nth-element access, membership and first-occurrence search, duplicate-suppressing insertion, single-occurrence removal by compaction, callback-based traversal, and full list copying. Within mc it is the reusable low-level collection for machine-word-sized data, parallel to lists and alists but specialized for SYSTEM.WORD rather than ADDRESS payloads.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for WORD lists, defining the chunk record with fixed-size WORD arrays and next links, and implementing append, lookup, removal, traversal, and duplication. Unlike wlists.def, it provides the concrete storage scheme and procedure bodies instead of only the interface.
